heroLead: A family resort an hour from Tashkent — with its own mill, apiary and stables.
roomsLead: Four room categories — from a cosy standard to a family suite with a balcony.
farmLead: Bread from our own flour, honey from the apiary, water from the spring — the resort lives off its own farm.
bookingLead: Call or message us — we'll help you choose a room and answer any questions.

howLead: The resort is in Khumsan village, about an hour's drive from Tashkent. Use the photos of the turns as landmarks.
howToGetLead: From the highway to our gates — a few clear turns. Open the map or follow the steps below.

heading1: You're going to fall in love with nature
paragraph1: Surrounded by untouched landscapes and soothing silence, our resort invites you to reconnect with nature in its purest form. Wake up to breathtaking views, explore serene walking trails, and let the gentle sounds of the forest heal your soul. Whether you're seeking adventure or calm, nature here becomes more than a backdrop — it becomes a part of your story
paragraph2: Nestled in the heart of nature, our resort offers a perfect blend of comfort and tranquility. Whether you're here for a weekend getaway or a long retreat, every detail is crafted to help you relax, recharge, and reconnect with what matters most

stableP: Our resort features a beautiful and well-maintained horse stable, perfect for guests who want to experience horseback riding in nature. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced rider, our horses are ready to welcome you.
flourMillp: All flour-based products on the resort are made using flour milled in our own traditional mill. We grind natural grains using time-honored methods, preserving their full taste and nutritional value. Our bread, flatbreads, and pastries are baked daily — from our flour, with care for your well-being.
apiaryP: Visit our apiary to see how pure, natural honey is made. Discover the fascinating world of bees and enjoy fresh honey straight from the source.
poolP: Enjoy a refreshing swim in our clean pools filled with natural spring water. Separate pools for men and women ensure comfort and privacy.
